Things about me: Hello, this is MisShenanigans from House Shenanigans. I am a student at the University of British Columbia. I was born in a small town in Southernwest Chinese coast. My undergraduate degree was done in the department of Mathmathics from the the same institution. From the MDS program I am hoping to learn more about data science and its applications in the real world.
Things I do I mean I am writing a novel and I am hoping to one day publish it but I probably have a long way to go from there.

title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
It technically has been two weeks since MDS program has started. At this point I am just happy to be here. This year the undergraudate (and rest of the school) had their first day started relatively late which means most of my socializing / bonding really only started at the second week. I guess in this blog post I will show some cool pics I took:



My friend’s booth on imagine day (before they could properly set things up).


Imagine day was pretty exciting for me, being away from this place for a year, I was hoping to run into more people I knew. Sadly, most people I knew from undergraduate years were all more or less graduated by now, but it was still nice to see a few familiar faces.



A MLP inspired Labubu clone I found on the ground).


I saw this thingy at one morning after the MDS lectures, it looks so sad on the ground. I have thought of taking it for myself but it really won’t go well with the fit and style I am trying out for this year. I left it on a branch eventually.



Dino poops… Don’t ask me how I found this).


Ah… well, there will be no context provided for this one.
